assumptions: The assessed submission concerns an investment product administered by IPD.
The relevant act is an application or submission made on or after 30 November 2024.
“Via e-IP” means the submission was actually made through the e-IP system, rather than an existing channel.
The Boolean result evaluates satisfaction of the stated submission-route condition for one identified application or submission within the formal scope.
A date on or after 30 November 2024 is within the full-adoption period described by the circular.
A recurring annual fee payment alone is not classified as an application or submission merely because e-IP supports that payment.

citations.quote: After the extended period, applications and submissions of investment products administered by the Investment Products Division (IPD)1 must be submitted to IPD via e-IP from 30 November 2024.
Starting 30 November 2024, ie, after the parallel run period, applications and submissions of investment products administered by IPD must be submitted via e-IP.
During this period, the SFC continues to accept applications and submissions via existing channels.

The current submission requests from IPD via the IP E-submission system will be integrated into e-IP, including reporting of net asset values, large redemptions and suspensions of dealing. In addition, e-IP users can also settle recurring annual fees associated with relevant investment products through the new system.

1 Investment-linked assurance schemes, mandatory provident fund products, open-ended fund companies, paper gold schemes, pooled retirement funds, real estate investment trusts, unit trusts and mutual funds and unlisted structured investment products.

reading.distinction: Applicability depends on the assessed act, product administration and submission date; route satisfaction depends on actual submission through e-IP. An out-of-scope act is not a failed route condition. Component review also distinguishes mandatory applications and submissions, including the identified reporting requests, from the separately described ability to pay recurring annual fees. The system is a submission object, not an actor.

reading.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] For an application or submission concerning an IPD-administered investment product made on or after 30 November 2024, the result answers whether the actual submission route satisfies the stated e-IP condition: true means submitted to IPD through e-IP; false means not submitted through e-IP. Outside that scope the result is not applicable. Unknown facts remain unknown. This evaluates only the route condition and confers no legal approval.
reading.subject: One application or submission of an investment product

relationships: The submitting participant makes an application or submission concerning an investment product to IPD.
The SFC circular requires covered applications and submissions to reach IPD through e-IP from 30 November 2024.
e-IP is hosted on WINGS and provides the submission channel.
The extended parallel-run period precedes mandatory adoption.
Existing IP E-submission requests, including reporting of net asset values, large redemptions and dealing suspensions, are to be integrated into e-IP.
Recurring annual fee payment is described as an additional system capability.
proposals.temporal_basis: The date of the assessed submission controls applicability: the extended parallel run ends on 29 November 2024 and the mandatory e-IP route begins on 30 November 2024. Product authorisation date is not substituted for submission date.
proposals.unit_of_assessment: One identified application or submission concerning one investment product; separate reporting or payment acts require separate classification.
